name: Document Locator
description_en: Document Locator is ColumbiaSoft’s document control system for Windows and web access. It combines file versions, approval workflows, permissions and records of activity for quality documents, HR files and project information. It can be hosted through the vendor’s Azure service or deployed on customer-managed Windows Server and SQL infrastructure. Keeping a newest file version is separate from identifying the revision approved for use.
description_zh: Document Locator 是 ColumbiaSoft 面向 Windows 及网页访问的文档控制系统，将文件版本、审批流、权限及活动记录结合，用于质量文档、人事文件和项目信息。可采用厂商 Azure 托管，也可部署于客户管理的 Windows Server 与 SQL 基础设施。保留最新文件版本与辨认获准使用的修订是不同任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Optional workflows track viewing and acknowledgement, with a separate signed-copy option.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可选流程跟踪查看及确认，并另有签署副本选项。

sections.title_en: Identify the approved copy at the point of use
sections.title_zh: 在使用位置辨认获准副本
sections.en:
Document Locator combines a Windows-oriented document interface with browser access and controls for versions, approvals and permissions. Its versioning documentation distinguishes a checked-in file version from the specific controlled revision approved and published. Merely finding the newest file does not answer which instructions a worker should use.

For an editorial pilot, use a synthetic equipment-cleaning instruction with a document ID, owner, draft change and currently effective revision. Ask a reader and an editor to retrieve the instruction through their actual intended client. Record the identity and status each sees. Then define what makes an obsolete copy recognizable in a printed or exported rendition. The published feature pages do not establish every watermark, retention or distribution behavior for a configured installation. No document, user or controlled copy was created.
sections.zh:
Document Locator 将偏 Windows 的文档界面与浏览器访问、版本审批及权限控制结合。版本文档区分签入文件版本与获批准发布的特定受控修订。找到最新文件，并不回答员工应使用哪份操作说明。

编辑建议的试点可用虚构设备清洁说明，含文档号、责任人、草拟修改及当前有效修订。让读者和编辑通过各自目标客户端检索，记录各自看到的身份及状态。再明确打印或导出副本中如何辨认过时版本。公开功能页未确立配置系统每种水印、保留或分发行为。本研究未创建文档、用户或受控副本。

sections.title_en: Promoting history is a change that needs review
sections.title_zh: 将历史版提升为当前也是待审变更
sections.en:
New check-ins receive version numbers and may carry searchable notes. Authorized users can inspect or promote earlier versions; the system also supports edits to earlier versions and subversion trees. Administrators can restrict users to the latest version or allow historical access. Those capabilities make an explicit approval policy necessary when earlier content returns to current use.

For the proposed instruction, introduce a correction, review the differences and record the reason for the new revision. Then evaluate promotion of a known prior version and inspect the resulting current status and history. Do not assume that promotion also recreates an earlier approval, notification or acknowledgement state. Check which audience can still reach historical instructions. Exact numbering, promotion side effects and approval invalidation were not established in the public pages. No check-in, promotion or comparison was performed.
sections.zh:
新签入会获得版本号，并可带有可搜索备注。授权用户可检查或提升旧版本，系统也支持编辑旧版及建立子版本树。管理员可将用户限制为仅最新版本，或允许访问历史。这些能力意味着旧内容重新成为当前内容时，需有明确审批政策。

建议说明样例应加入修正、审查差异并记录新修订原因，再评估提升已知旧版，检查当前状态和历史。不能假定提升同时恢复过去审批、通知或确认状态；还需检查哪些人仍能访问历史说明。公开页面未确立精确编号、提升副作用及审批失效机制。本研究未执行签入、提升或比较。

sections.title_en: Set completion rules for the actual review task
sections.title_zh: 按实际审查任务设定完成规则
sections.en:
Workflow supports serial, parallel and conditional steps, alternate assignees and timeout events. The documented team mode allows any team member to complete a step; that is different from requiring every member’s decision. Approval routing can record individual or multiple approvals and branch according to status. Quality-control points may sample workflow instances rather than inspect all of them.

For the synthetic instruction, distinguish technical review, release approval and a response to rejection. Determine whether one representative or all designated reviewers are required at each step, then verify the configuration rather than relying on a team label. Exercise an unavailable assignee and inspect whether a timeout merely sends a reminder or changes ownership. A notification is not a completed approval. Exact quorum rules, restart behavior and changes to an in-flight document remain evaluation questions. No workflow, reminder or reassignment was run.
sections.zh:
工作流支持串行、并行和条件步骤、备用处理人及超时事件。文档所述团队模式允许任一成员完成步骤，与要求每人作出决定不同。审批路由可记录单人或多人审批，并按状态分支；质量控制点还可能抽样检查流程实例，而非全检。

虚构说明应区分技术审查、发布审批及拒绝后的处理。逐步确定由一名代表还是所有指定审查者决定，再验证配置，不能只依赖团队标签。需检查处理人缺席时，超时究竟仅发提醒还是改变责任归属。通知不等于审批完成。精确人数阈值、重启及在途文档变化仍需评估。本研究未运行流程、提醒或重新分配。

sections.title_en: Acknowledgement and external signing have separate prerequisites
sections.title_zh: 阅读确认与外部签署各有前提
sections.en:
The optional Required Reading workflow checks that a recipient opened and viewed the file before completing the task. Reports track outstanding assignments, and new group members can receive earlier assignments. The separate Read and Acknowledge option stores a signed confirmation copy in the employee folder. These records document actions and attestations; they do not independently measure comprehension.

The optional DocuSign Connector adds a send-for-signature step using a separately purchased DocuSign API account. The signed file returns as a new version and the workflow can continue. For the proposed instruction, decide whether the requirement is distribution, an employee acknowledgement or a contractual signature before choosing an option. Confirm the actual recipient, document revision and returned record. Connector retry, duplicate-send handling and signature identity/legal requirements were not evaluated. No reading assignment, employee folder, DocuSign account connection or signature request was made.
sections.zh:
可选 Required Reading 流程在收件人完成任务前检查其已打开并查看文件。报告跟踪未完成任务，新组员可收到过去任务。另有 Read and Acknowledge 选项，将签署确认副本存入员工文件夹。这些记录体现动作和声明，不独立衡量理解程度。

可选 DocuSign Connector 使用另购的 DocuSign API 账户添加发送签署步骤。签署文件作为新版本返回，流程可继续。对于建议说明样例，应先确定要求是分发、员工确认还是合同签署，再选择选项，并确认实际收件人、文档修订和返回记录。未评估连接器重试、防重复发送及签署身份法律要求。本研究未创建阅读任务、员工文件夹、DocuSign 连接或签署请求。

sections.title_en: Check the reader’s client and effective access
sections.title_zh: 检查读者客户端及实际访问
sections.en:
Document Locator describes user/group privileges at folder and file levels, application-function restrictions, database security and document activity logs. Those are distinct layers. The requirements page explicitly says not every feature is available in every browser or operating system; Windows desktop requirements also differ from web access.

For the pilot, define separate reader, editor and release-approver tasks. Inspect search results, opening, historical versions, export and approval through the intended client, using only synthetic content. Verify that a person who can find an item cannot perform an unintended action. Record the source version for an exported copy, since repository controls do not by themselves establish control over every downstream copy. The exact inheritance, deny precedence, audit immutability and log retention were not documented in the reviewed page. No access control, export or audit query was executed.
sections.zh:
Document Locator 描述文件夹及文件级用户组权限、应用功能限制、数据库安全和文档活动日志，这些是不同层次。要求页明确指出，并非所有浏览器及操作系统都有全部功能；Windows 桌面与网页访问的要求也不同。

试点应分别定义读者、编辑及发布审批任务，仅用虚构内容通过目标客户端检查检索结果、打开、历史版本、导出和审批。需确认能找到项目的人不能执行非预期动作。导出应记录来源版本，因为资料库控制本身不能确立对所有下游副本的控制。已读页面未说明精确继承、拒绝优先级、审计不可变性及日志保留。本研究未执行访问控制、导出或审计查询。

sections.title_en: Separate a backup schedule from a demonstrated restore
sections.title_zh: 区分备份计划与经验证恢复
sections.en:
Vendor hosting uses Azure, with ColumbiaSoft maintaining server operations and upgrades. The page describes weekly database backups and daily incremental backups with 28-day wording, and includes Microsoft server and SQL licensing. It does not state a guaranteed restore time, recovery point or complete tenant export. Customer-managed deployment has a different operations boundary.

The on-premise requirements exclude SQL Server Express. WebTools requires IIS and a certificate issued by a third-party CA; self-signed certificates are unsupported. For the instruction pilot, verify the selected components and supported versions, then define recovery of records, permissions, workflows and attachments together. Obtain the host’s actual region, restore procedure and exit format. The legacy customer program assigns local backup testing to the customer, but current order applicability must be confirmed. No installation, certificate, SQL, backup or recovery operation was attempted.
sections.zh:
厂商托管使用 Azure，由 ColumbiaSoft 维护服务器运行及升级。页面描述每周数据库备份和带 28 天表述的每日增量备份，并包含 Microsoft 服务器及 SQL 许可，却未规定保证恢复时间、恢复点或完整租户导出。客户管理部署的运维边界不同。

自托管要求排除 SQL Server Express。WebTools 需要 IIS 及第三方 CA 签发证书，不支持自签证书。说明文档试点需核对所选组件及受支持版本，再一同定义记录、权限、流程及附件恢复。还应取得实际托管地区、恢复方法和退出格式。旧版客户计划将本地备份测试分配给客户，但其当前订单适用性需确认。本研究未尝试安装、证书、SQL、备份或恢复。

sections.title_en: Obtain the license and service scope behind the quote
sections.title_zh: 取得报价背后的许可与服务范围
sections.en:
The pricing page offers a quote based on users, deployment and integrations, with core capabilities and support/training language. It publishes no numerical fee in the reviewed body. The older customer-program PDF separates training and implementation from technical support and places restrictions on core customization. Current service scope should be resolved in the order rather than inferred by combining those documents.

The full EULA linked by the PDF was not accessible in the public reader, so exact software rights, renewal, termination and refund conditions remain unverified. No open-source classification is inferred from a paid quote, self-hosting or an open API. Website privacy provisions cover contact, account, payment and device/browser information; they do not establish tenant-document retention or backup erasure. For the proposed deployment, obtain the license, hosting/support terms and exit obligations together before committing. No form, quote request, account, software download or agreement acceptance occurred.
sections.zh:
价格页按用户、部署及集成提供报价，描述核心能力和支持培训，但已读正文没有数值费用。较旧客户计划 PDF 将培训实施与技术支持分开，并限制核心软件定制。当前服务范围应在订单解决，不能靠拼接这些文档推断。

PDF 所链完整 EULA 无法经公开读取器访问，因此精确软件权利、续费、终止和退款条件未核实。不依据付费报价、自托管或开放 API 推断开源分类。网站隐私规定涉及联系、账户、支付和设备浏览器信息，不能确立租户文档保留或备份擦除。建议部署在承诺前应一同取得许可、托管支持条款及退出义务。本研究未提交表单、询价、建号、下载软件或接受协议。
